mission.title: Mission
mission.text: Promote and implement logistics development strategies, stimulating competitiveness and excellence in transport and procurement delivery.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be a reference in cargo transport and procurement on the South Africa–Mozambique corridor, with robust and sustainable operations.

services.title: Our Services
services.intro: We transport and manage your cargo on the Johannesburg–Maputo corridor, with procurement in South Africa and delivery in Mozambique. Modern fleet, real-time tracking and integrated door-to-door logistics — all with a single partner.

transport.title: Road Transport
transport.desc: Cargo transport on the Johannesburg–Maputo corridor and regional routes. Modern fleet and 24h tracking.

procurement.title: Procurement
procurement.desc: Purchase and acquisition of goods in South Africa with delivery in Mozambique. Single source, integrated logistics.

tracking.title: Real-Time Tracking
tracking.desc: Track your cargo at any time via app or web panel, from warehouse to destination.

logistics.title: Integrated Logistics
logistics.desc: Warehousing, picking, despatch and door-to-door delivery. South Africa to Mozambique with a single partner.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Quick answers to our customers' most common questions.

q1.question: What types of cargo does Lirandzo transport?
q1.answer: We transport general, fractional, containerised and special volume cargo.

q2.question: How can I track my shipment?
q2.answer: Go to the "Track Order" page and enter the tracking code provided on dispatch.

q3.question: What is the delivery time?
q3.answer: National deliveries take 1 to 5 business days. International routes between 5 to 15 business days.

q4.question: How do I request a quote?
q4.answer: Fill out the form on the "Request Quote" page. We respond within 24 business hours.
